data.body_html:
Planning a boat trip on the Costa del Sol without a licence? In 2030, marbella boat rental no license prices remain transparent and all-inclusive. We compare current rates for 5–12 guests, all departing from Puerto Banús. Every charter includes a skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA — no hidden extras. Here's your complete price guide for 2030.

How No-License Boat Rental Works in Marbella

You don't need any paperwork. All our boats come with a professional skipper who handles navigation, mooring, and safety. You just bring your group, choose your route, and enjoy. Typical day trips head east to Cabopino or west to Estepona, with stops for swimming at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés. The skipper knows the best spots and will tailor the itinerary to your preferences.

Marbella Boat Rental No License Prices 2030: Tier A

For groups up to 11 guests, our Tier A boats offer the best value:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) — €749/2h, €1,199/4h, €2,299/8h
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) — €749/2h, €1,199/4h, €2,299/8h

Both depart from Puerto Banús and include all standard inclusions. The 2-hour option is perfect for a sunset cruise along the Golden Mile. The 8-hour full-day charter lets you reach Sotogrande for lunch and return via the Marbella coast.

Marbella Boat Rental No License Prices 2030: Tier B

For larger groups or those wanting more space and speed, Tier B starts at a 4-hour minimum:

  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) — €4,719/4h (jet ski included free)
  • Mangusta 80 Grey (24m, 12 pax) — €4,719/4h (jet ski included free)

These 24-metre flybridge yachts offer plenty of deck space, a sunpad, and a jet ski for water sports. Ideal for a half-day adventure to Cala Cortés or a longer cruise to Estepona.

Other Boats: Pricing on Request

For our remaining fleet — including the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax), Pershing 46 (14m, 10 pax), and smaller boats like the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) — prices are available via WhatsApp. Simply tell us your group size, preferred date, and duration, and we'll quote you within hours. No obligation.

What's Included in Every Charter

Our Marbella boat rental no license packages are truly all-inclusive. You won't pay extra for fuel, crew, or taxes. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed skipper (English & Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the full duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Full insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21% VAT)

There are no hidden fees. The price you see is the price you pay.

Which Boat Should You Choose?

For a couple or small family, the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are budget-friendly options. For a group of 8–10 friends, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 offer the best balance of cost and comfort. For a luxury experience with jet ski, go for the Mangusta 80. All boats are moored in Puerto Banús, making departure quick and scenic.

Book Your No-License Charter Today

Ready to compare marbella boat rental no license prices 2030? Browse our fleet and book directly online or message us on WhatsApp for personalised advice. With transparent pricing and no hidden costs, your perfect day on the water is just a click away.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need a boat license to rent a boat in Marbella?

No. All our charters include a licensed skipper who handles navigation, docking, and safety. You simply relax and enjoy the coastline — no paperwork or exam required.

What is included in the marbella boat rental no license prices?

Every charter includes a professional skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No surprise charges.

How much does a no-license boat rental cost in 2030?

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours up to €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B (Mangusta 80) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours with a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Which boats can I rent without a license?

All our boats are available without a license: from the 5-pax Dubhe and Mariah SX21 to the 12-pax Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, and Canados 86. Each comes with a skipper.

Where do the boats depart from?

All charters depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella. You can also arrange pick-ups from Marbella Marina, Cabopino, or Estepona on request.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes. We provide a selection of drinks and snacks, but you're welcome to bring extra food, drinks, or a cake for a celebration. There's no corkage fee.

What is the cancellation policy?

Cancellations made 48+ hours before departure receive a full refund. Within 48 hours, a 50% charge applies. No-shows are non-refundable. Weather-related cancellations are fully refundable.

How do I book a no-license boat rental?

You can book directly on our website or contact us via WhatsApp for personalised advice. We recommend booking at least 3–5 days in advance, especially in summer.
